title: Lightning bolt with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boltGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE44D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB800'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Lightning bolt shape -->
  <polygon points='48,8 28,52 44,52 36,92 72,42 54,42 64,8' fill='url(#boltGrad)' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='46' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2B2B5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='45.5' cy='44' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='46' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2B2B5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='57.5' cy='44' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43,56 Q50,66 57,56' fill='none' stroke='#2B2B5C' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF8C69' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF8C69' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#FFFACD' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='2' fill='#FFFACD' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='24' r='1.8' fill='#FFFACD' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
